profiles.title: The Ascension
profiles.subject: Feasts

overview.text: The Mother of God parish places the Ascension on the fortieth day after Pascha, a Thursday. Its icon explanation connects the enthroned and ascending Lord with His continuing blessing, teaching, and guidance of the Church.

sourceRefs.locator: About the feast; About the Icon, paragraphs 1–2

overview.reason: Necessary concise account of a modern published explanation; full prose reproduction rights have not been established.

blocks.text: Christ appears above in a mandorla, blessing with one hand and holding a scroll. Below, the Mother of God stands calmly in prayer between angels, while the disciples look upward and gesture. The article identifies the assembled group with the Church.
blocks.reason: Necessary concise account of a modern published explanation; full prose reproduction rights have not been established.

blocks.text: The selected icon is attributed to an unidentified painter of Candia and dated to the second half of the fifteenth century. Its published description identifies the Mount of Olives, the apostles, the Mother of God, and angels carrying Christ’s circular glory.

sourceRefs.locator: File description and displayed historic reproduction

blocks.reason: Necessary English description of the selected historic artwork and its published object metadata; no new theological interpretation.

blocks.text: The parish notes that Paul appears in the common composition although he was not an eyewitness to the Ascension. His inclusion makes the image an account of the Church’s fullness and commission, rather than a photograph-like roster of the historical gathering.

images.title: Ascension (Candia, 15th c.).jpg
images.description: Η Ανάληψη δεύτερο μισό 15ου αιώνα, 55,5x66,2εκ. άγνωστος ζωγράφος του Χάνδακα Ο Χριστός με ενδύματα απαστράπτοντα από φως ανεβαίνει στον ουρανό, μέσα σε στρογγυλή δόξα, που κρατούν δύο άγγελοι. Στο έδαφος βρίσκονται οι απόστολοι σε δύο ομάδες γύρω από τη Θεοτόκο, την οποία πλαισιώνουν δύο λευκοντυμένοι άγγελοι. Στο βάθος εικονίζεται το όρος των Ελαιών.
